evidence.head_shape: Both figures (crops w19_hs_fig0_head.png, w19_hs_fig1_head.png), compared directly against refs/base/base.png (w19_base_head.png) and against the REJECTED refs/base/handshake.png (w19_rej_fig0_head.png): both candidate heads are large, near-perfect round circles matching base.png's skull shape and scale. Critically, the eyes are drawn with base.png's signature hooded/droopy eyelid (a crescent eyelid-shadow line cutting into the top of the eye, small pupil positioned high, only the lower portion of white sclera showing) -- the exact style Daniel's earlier ruling required. This is visibly different from the REJECTED reference, whose eyes are large, fully round, wide-open circles with much more white sclera visible all around the pupil and no drooping eyelid line -- the specific defect the rerun was commissioned to fix. Both candidate figures use the corrected hooded-eye style identically.
evidence.no_nose_no_ears: Verified on both figures individually (w19_hs_fig0_head.png, w19_hs_fig1_head.png): plain round bald heads, two eyebrows, two hooded eyes and a small closed-mouth line only -- no nose bump/bridge/nostril on either figure, no ear shape or inner-ear line on either side of either head, matching base.png's minimal treatment exactly.
evidence.four_digit_hands: Clasp (crop w19_hs_clasp.png): the near hand shows a thumb plus four rounded curled-finger knuckle bumps wrapping the grip -- the simplified mitt convention, not a five-digit realistic hand, no fusion. Each figure's free hanging hand (crops w19_hs_fig0_free.png, w19_hs_fig1_free.png) independently shows the same mitt shape with a thumb plus 3 finger-separation lines. Consistent on both figures.

Candidate fig0 (left) = 3.36 (964px/287px), fig1 (right) = 3.37 (964px/286px).
